name: gameplay-luxury-start
origin: The gameplay screen at the round's first frame on the Luxury Stores stage set (checkpoint 5, third stage set): as gameplay-cinema-start (seed 42, Arcade, Normal, robot 0, through the real menus), but Game Settings' stage list picks Luxury Shop (mysteriousStages, GameSettingsUI.stagesHandle: GameModel.stages = "LuxuryStores"; the click is the centre of its stage bounds in the game-settings dropdown golden). The capture is the first frame without UI_reading, 61 frames after START.
godot_note: Robots are drawn from their original clips (scripts/ui/game_actors.gd); the node diff and the pixel score include them.

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the luxury-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
